hypothesis: A frozen x86 branch filter before one raw LZMA2 stream reconstructs the ELI executable and dictionary while reducing complete stored-program bytes and preserving the B2 archive.
interfaces_exposed: One raw x86 plus LZMA2 payload; fixed executable split offset; identical cmix and dictionary bytes
kill_condition: Reject if complete package is not smaller than the solid-LZMA parent or if any payload, archive, roundtrip, determinism, or guard differs.
promotion_condition: Complete program package is smaller than the solid-LZMA parent, split payloads are byte-identical, and exact 250K archive, roundtrip, determinism, and memory match B2.
title: X86-filtered solid LZMA2 package for stripped B2 runtime
